notes.title: 🔧 UI Update Live! Spinner: Rogueblade Demo Updated
notes.content:
[p]Hey Spinner warriors! 🌀
A new user interface (UI) update has arrived for the Spinner: Rogueblade demo. We've revamped everything from menus to in-game experience based on your feedback.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648783/900b8ac558dafa7f31f4cf5c4b649e01db5bcbda.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]🖥️ What's Changed?[/h3][list][*][p][b]Modern and Theme-Appropriate Menu Design:[/b]
With brand new visuals and animations, everything now fits better with the Spinner: Rogueblade universe.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Detailed Settings Menu:[/b]
We've gone beyond the old plain menu. Explore more options from sound and music levels to graphics. (It might still be basic, but it's improving!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad Support in Main Menu:[/b]
You can now navigate menus with a gamepad. We're one step closer to that console feel![/p][/*][*][p][b]More Intuitive In-Game UI:[/b]
Health, energy, and character icons are now clearer and more functional.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]🛠️ These improvements came thanks to your feedback. Keep sharing your ideas during the demo process — because we're shaping this world together.[/p][p]💬 We're waiting for your comments!
🧡 Thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: Spinner Madness on Steam Deck! 🌀🎮
notes.content:
[p]Hello [b]Spinner: Rogueblade[/b] players! 🌀[/p][p]Great news for our Steam Deck users! We've thoroughly tested our game on Steam Deck and are proud to announce it is currently [b]fully playable[/b].[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🕹️ Controls[/h3][p]The game works flawlessly with Deck's integrated gamepad controls. All systems, including menu and interface navigation, are easily accessible. Additionally, some actions can optionally be performed via touchscreen.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ Performance[/h3][p][b]On Steam Deck, our game runs smoothly with stable FPS.[/b] We observed stable performance even on medium-high graphics settings. We also plan to add an optimized graphics preset for battery-powered users.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Visual and UI Compatibility[/h3][p]Interface sizes and text are designed for clear readability on small screens. Clarity is maintained especially in combat scenes.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]💬 Your Feedback Matters![/h3][p]Don't hesitate to share your Steam Deck experience with us. We eagerly await your feedback to further improve the game.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🎮 It's time to fight anywhere with [b]Spinner: Rogueblade[/b] – whether on desktop or Steam Deck!
Thank you for your support![/p]

notes.title: Demo is Live! 🔥
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Spinner warriors![/p][p]🌀 [b]Spinner: Rogueblade[/b] demo is finally live!
In the first 10 hours, hundreds of players from over 60 countries have joined and shared their experiences.[/p][p]Have you played it yet? Don’t forget to share your thoughts, suggestions, and any bug reports with us![/p][p]🎯 What’s your favorite feature? Is there anything you think is missing?[/p][p]💬 You can leave a comment below or write a short review on our Steam page.
Every feedback is very valuable to us![/p][p]Thank you! 🙌
— The [b]Spinner: Rogueblade[/b] Team[/p]
